entities.summary: Rachel (Raquel) Chan is a pioneering Argentine biochemist from the Santa Fe Province in Argentina. Her work has centered on photosynthesis, and she has invented multiple drought-resistant seeds. She is the Director of the Agrobiotechnology Institute of Santa Fe (IAL). Chan was named one of the ten most outstanding women scientists in Latin America by the BBC.
